exposure: Abnormal middle cerebral artery Doppler studies
cohort: A 31-year-old woman with decreased fetal movements at 34 weeks gestation and 35 cases of Intraplacental choriocarcinoma (IC) associated with fetomaternal hemorrhage (FMH) identified through a systematic review.
finding: Intraplacental choriocarcinoma (IC) with fetomaternal hemorrhage (FMH) is a rare but life-threatening condition associated with high perinatal mortality, requiring high clinical suspicion and prompt placental histopathology for diagnosis.
mod_finding: An emergency cesarean section was performed in the reported case due to decreased fetal movements.
